crossRefs.note: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your…
Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go…
Into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.
He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, wallet, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”
“Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’

parallels.note: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body…

translations.web: Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.
translations.bsb: And do not be concerned about what you will eat or drink. Do not worry about it.
translations.kjv: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
translations.asv: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, and what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
